requirements.description: User requires energy class C or better, so all classes from A1 to C are accepted.
User explicitly wants the property near public transport. Threshold set at the 75th percentile of mobility (70.93), rounded to 71.
A university student residence clearly needs nearby universities and schools. Threshold set at the 75th percentile of education (75.14), rounded to 75.
The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area, which is a direct surface requirement.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 850 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on surface_area (>= 850 sqm), a 3.0 km haversine radius around 45.0677551, 7.6824892, energy_class in A1-A4/B/C, mobility >= 71 and education >= 75. Results are ordered by distance from the coordinate, nearest first. Only the extracted requirements are applied; the office-use type and 60-occupant capacity from the user query have no matching extracted requirement, so they are not filtered.
